<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_data_source"><sys_data_source action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><batch_size>100000</batch_size><category/><connection_override_last_success_time/><connection_timeout>0</connection_timeout><connection_url/><connection_url_parameters/><csv_delimiter/><data_in_single_column>false</data_in_single_column><data_loader><![CDATA[(function loadData(import_set_table, data_source, import_log, last_success_import_time) {

    try {

        var r = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2(
            'x_cesy_service_gr.Ceburu Provider',
            'Get Ceburu Devices'
        );

        var responseMessage = r.execute();

        var responseBody = JSON.parse(responseMessage.getBody());

        var httpStatus = responseMessage.getStatusCode();

        if (httpStatus != 200) {
            gs.error('Ceburu API returned status: ' + httpStatus);
            return;
        }

        var devices = responseBody.result.results;

        for (var j = 0; j < devices.length; j++) {

            var net = devices[j];

            var spec = (net.specifications &&
                net.specifications[0]) ?
                net.specifications[0] : {};

            var dev = net.device || {};

            var importRecord = {};

            // =========================
            // Core Identification
            // =========================

            importRecord.name = spec.hostname;

            importRecord.ip_address = spec.ipaddress;

            importRecord.serial_number = spec.serialno;

            // =========================
            // Manufacturer / Model
            // =========================

            importRecord.manufacturer = spec.vendor || 'Cisco';

            importRecord.model_number = spec.model;

            // =========================
            // OS Information
            // =========================

            importRecord.os = spec.osname || 'NX-OS';

            importRecord.os_version =
                spec.softwareversion ||
                spec.currentversion ||
                spec.primaryversion;

            // =========================
            // MAC Address
            // =========================

            importRecord.mac_address = spec.basemac;

            // =========================
            // Operational Status
            // =========================

            importRecord.operational_status =
                spec.status === true ? 1 : 2;

            // =========================
            // Discovery Metadata
            // =========================

            importRecord.last_discovered =
                spec.lastupdated;

            // =========================
            // Custom Fields
            // =========================

            importRecord.u_health_status =
                spec.health;

            importRecord.u_cpu_usage_percent =
                spec.cpu;

            importRecord.u_memory_usage_percent =
                spec.memory;

            importRecord.u_uptime =
                spec.uptime;

            importRecord.u_up_since =
                spec.upsince;

            importRecord.u_last_config_change =
                spec.lastconfchangetime;

            importRecord.u_snmp_status =
                spec.snmppoolstatus;

            importRecord.u_stp_change_count =
                spec.stpchanges;

            importRecord.u_total_traffic =
                spec.traffic;

            importRecord.u_license =
                spec.license;

            // =========================
            // Optional Metadata
            // =========================

            importRecord.u_aiopsconfigmanagement_id =
                dev.aiopsconfigmanagement_id;

            importRecord.u_network_id =
                dev.id;

            if (spec.productdescr) {
                importRecord.short_description =
                    spec.productdescr;
            }

            // =========================
            // Insert Import Row
            // =========================

            import_set_table.insert(importRecord);
        }

    } catch (ex) {

        gs.error(
            'Data Source (Ceburu Network Switches) Error: ' +
            ex.message
        );
    }

})(import_set_table, data_source, import_log, last_success_import_time);]]></data_loader><database_name/><database_port/><discard_arrays>false</discard_arrays><enable_parallel_loading>false</enable_parallel_loading><expand_node_children>false</expand_node_children><file_path/><file_retrieval_method>Attachment</file_retrieval_method><format>JSON</format><glide_keystore>false</glide_keystore><header_row>0</header_row><import_set_table_label>Ceburu IP Switch Device</import_set_table_label><import_set_table_name>x_cesy_service_gr_ceburu_ip_switch_device</import_set_table_name><instance_name/><jdbc_password/><jdbc_server/><jdbc_user_name/><jpath_root_node>/results/results</jpath_root_node><last_run_database_field/><last_run_datetime/><last_success_import_time>2026-05-20 15:22:16</last_success_import_time><ldap_target/><ldapprobe_result_set_rows>200</ldapprobe_result_set_rows><limit>50</limit><maximum_rows/><mid_server/><name>Ceburu IP Switch Device</name><offset>0</offset><oracle_port>1521</oracle_port><oracle_sid>orcl</oracle_sid><parallel_loading_script><![CDATA[(function loadTasks(parallel_job_loader, data_source, import_log, last_success_import_time) {
